Name: Nightwork
Author: ASUsername
Description:
2点以后可以熬夜，但会有相应的惩罚。
You can stay up after 2, but there are penalties.

如果时间超过3点，将添加移速-1.5的减益，并每秒扣除3点体力。
If the time is more than 3 points, the shift speed minus 1.5 is added and 10 points of strength is deducted per second.
如果时间超过4点，将添加移速-2.5的减益，并每秒扣除10点体力。
If the time is more than 4 points, the shift speed minus -2.5 is added and 30 points per second is deducted.
第二天还将有一个持续一段时间的移速与攻击力减益。
The next day there will also be a movement speed and attack damage reduction that will last for a period of time.
